mechanism: Moxifloxacin may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing budesonide metabolism inhibition and systemic corticosteroid exposure, while concurrent use increases infection risk due to immunosuppression.
action: Monitor for signs of corticosteroid excess (hyperglycemia, hypertension, immunosuppression) and infection; consider alternative antibiotic if prolonged use anticipated; no dose adjustment typically required for short-term therapy.
